proof_body:
by
  intro f r θ a hf
  constructor
  · have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => (s : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) r := by
      simpa using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := r)).mul_const (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))
    have h := HasDerivAt.scomp r hf h1
    simpa [Function.comp_def, mul_comm] using h
  · have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) Complex.I θ := by
      simpa using (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := θ)).mul_const Complex.I
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) ((r : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I)) θ := by
      exact (HasDerivAt.cexp h0).const_mul (r : ℂ)
    have h := HasDerivAt.scomp θ hf h1
    have e : Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * (a * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) = ((r : ℂ) * (Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I) * Complex.I)) • a := by
      rw [smul_eq_mul]; ring
    rw [e]
    exact h
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (r θ : ℝ) (a : ℂ), HasDerivAt f a ((r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) → HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f ((s : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) (a * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I)) r ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f ((r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I))) (Complex.I * (r : ℂ) * (a * Complex.exp ((θ : ℂ) * Complex.I))) θ
